profile.name: Kevinas Ramoska
profile.headline: Full-stack engineer building reliable .NET business applications, automated tests, and secure user experiences.
profile.summary: Full stack engineer with commercial C#/.NET and Java/Spring Boot experience. Promoted from intern at BWG Foods, building ASP.NET Core and SQL Server portals for 206 stores; previously 17 months at General Motors on Spring Boot microservices and Kafka.
profile.availability: I am always happy to connect with engineers, product teams, and people building useful software.
profile.metaDescription: Kevinas Ramoska, Junior Full Stack Engineer at BWG Foods UC in Ireland. Explore C#/.NET, Java and React projects, case studies and technical writing.

proofPoints.title: Enterprise background
proofPoints.detail: Java, Kafka and React at General Motors

experiences.title: Junior Full Stack Engineer
highlights: Build ShopLinkPOS retailer and admin portals with ASP.NET Core MVC, Razor, EF Core and SQL Server for 206 stores (~500 users).
Introduced 49 Playwright/.NET E2E tests and xUnit, plus 5 Azure DevOps PR-validation pipelines and main-to-dev branch pipelines for .NET and ColdFusion.
Added SSO, permission-aware navigation and audit logging; resolved UAT issues with QA.

experiences.title: Full Stack Developer Intern
highlights: Upgraded the .NET MAUI Android/iOS app from .NET 8 to .NET 10.
Migrated OneTrust to PrivacyEngine and GA4 across 7 websites; extended Just Eat Q-commerce for age-restricted items.

experiences.title: Full-time Judo Athlete
highlights: Irish Senior Champion (2023); 7th at two Senior European Cups (+100 kg); competed across Europe, Japan, and Canada.

experiences.title: Software Engineer (Intern Jan 2023 - Sep 2023; Part-Time Sep 2023 - May 2024)
highlights: Delivered a new internal web app end to end for the Connected Vehicle Carrier Platform, replacing a legacy tool: React/Ant Design front end with Microsoft SSO (MSAL/Azure AD) and Python scripts seeding its data.
Built its Spring Boot sync service (JPA, OkHttp) comparing file-transfer records with an external API and syncing changes; refactored to single-responsibility services with JUnit/Mockito tests.
Part-time: built Spring Boot service and controller features and fixed bugs across 4 Kafka microservices.
Added ELK monitoring for activation events and Kafka messaging in SAFe sprints.

about: I develop and maintain retailer and administration applications using C#, ASP.NET Core, Razor, and SQL Server. My work spans product features, authentication, automated testing, production fixes, and CI/CD.

Before joining BWG full-time, I completed a full-stack internship there and worked with Java Spring Boot, React, PostgreSQL, and Kafka at General Motors. Those roles taught me to move comfortably between interfaces, services, data, testing, and delivery workflows.
